name: Deteccion Remota de Latido Cardiaco (rPPG)
description: Detecta senales fisiologicas de latido cardiaco del video facial para verificar la presencia humana.
useCase: Verifying real human presence in video through remote photoplethysmography analysis
mechanism: Extracts subtle color changes in facial skin caused by blood circulation (rPPG signal) and analyzes its temporal characteristics. Real faces exhibit periodic color fluctuations corresponding to heartbeat. AI-generated faces lack these physiological signals or produce incoherent patterns.
source: Ciftci, U. et al. (2020) - FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals, IEEE TPAMI
algorithm: rPPG Signal Extraction (CHROM/POS) + Power Spectrum Analysis + Physiological Plausibility Check
parameters: ROI: forehead + cheeks, Sampling: 30fps minimum, Window: 10 seconds, Frequency range: 0.7-4.0 Hz
